commands.name: auth login
commands.description: Sign in as the owner and store the returned token

commands.name: auth logout
commands.description: Clear the stored owner token

commands.name: auth whoami
commands.description: Show the signed-in owner identity

commands.name: configure
commands.description: View or update CLI settings (api_base, token)

commands.name: devices approve
commands.description: Approve a PENDING device, promoting it to TRUSTED (owner-authed)

commands.name: devices get
commands.description: Get a device by id

commands.name: devices list
commands.description: List the owner's trusted devices (newest first)

commands.name: devices pair
commands.description: Issue a short-TTL, single-use pairing code for a new device to redeem (owner-authed)

commands.name: devices redeem
commands.description: Redeem a pairing code as a NEW device; prints the one-time hub device token

commands.name: devices rename
commands.description: Rename a device (owner-authed)

commands.name: devices request
commands.description: Fallback join path: request pairing as a NEW device; prints an inert token that activates on owner approval

commands.name: devices revoke
commands.description: Immediately sever a device's access: flip it to REVOKED and revoke its authenticator session (owner-authed)

commands.name: devices setup
commands.description: Set up this hub's first device as the owner: claims the hub (first-owner-wins) and trusts this device directly — no pairing code. Run `auth login` first.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check API health

commands.name: transfer delete
commands.description: Delete an item and its blob (any trusted device of the owner may delete)

commands.name: transfer download
commands.description: Download an item's bytes to a local path, preserving the original filename

commands.name: transfer get
commands.description: Get a single item's metadata by id

commands.name: transfer list
commands.description: List the items this device may pull (broadcast, directed-to-it, or originated by it), newest first

commands.name: transfer send-text
commands.description: Send a text snippet to the trust group (or directed to one device)

commands.name: transfer upload
commands.description: Upload a file to the trust group (or directed to one device)
